detailed_descriptions.en: The legendary strip mahjong game "Super Real Mahjong" is back with a complete revival in cutting-edge 3D x VR! Win at mahjong, and the heroine takes off her clothes— The simple yet ultimate experience returns with unprecedented realism! ◇ Industry First: 3D Strip Actions! Overwhelming Presence! Dynamic angles unique to 3D and meticulously crafted direction! "She" is right in front of you—experience the ultimate strip scenes woven at a distance where you can even hear her breath! ◇Game Overview The monumental title of strip mahjong that once took Japanese arcades by storm makes a massive comeback after 30 years! Showko, the manager of the Mahjong Cafe "P's Club", explains: "Strip mahjong is a game of mahjong where the girl who loses takes off her clothes." Mizuki, Aya, Akira, and Showko— Intense matches with unique heroines begin now. What awaits you beyond victory...? ◇What is Strip Mahjong? Strip mahjong is a serious 1-on-1 battle where the heroine "strips when she loses"! This cutting-edge entertainment that secretly gained popularity in the corners of Japanese arcades 30 years ago revives in 2026. What's more! She will even take off the "very last piece" that was unseen back in the day—! ◇ Features The match screen dramatically evolves in 3D! Play mahjong alone together with the heroine—while she stays stripped! Through mahjong, you might just get to see a special side of her. You can even touch her during matches to enjoy her reactions...? Beginner-friendly! Fully equipped with Auto Mode "I don't know the rules of mahjong..." Don't worry if that's you! Features an Auto Mode that fully automates gameplay with a single button. Enjoy the story and strip scenes effortlessly. (Can be toggled ON/OFF at any time during matches) Complete freedom to toggle ON⇔OFF! Equipped with a "Compliance" feature to cover sensitive parts with a mysterious light Sensitive areas during mahjong matches and strip scenes can be covered with a "mysterious light." tPlease make use of this for gameplay in public places, streaming, etc.! tIn addition to toggling ON⇔OFF, the "size" can also be adjusted according to compliance strictness levels across different eras. Now, experience zero-distance undressing!!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The legendary strip mahjong game "Super Real Mahjong" is back with a complete revival in cutting-edge 3D x VR!

Win at mahjong, and the heroine takes off her clothes—

The simple yet ultimate experience returns with unprecedented realism!

◇ Industry First: 3D Strip Actions! Overwhelming Presence!

Dynamic angles unique to 3D and meticulously crafted direction!

"She" is right in front of you—experience the ultimate strip scenes woven at a distance where you can even hear her breath!

◇Game Overview

The monumental title of strip mahjong that once took Japanese arcades by storm makes a massive comeback after 30 years!

Showko, the manager of the Mahjong Cafe "P's Club", explains:

"Strip mahjong is a game of mahjong where the girl who loses takes off her clothes."

Mizuki, Aya, Akira, and Showko—

Intense matches with unique heroines begin now. What awaits you beyond victory...?

◇What is Strip Mahjong?

Strip mahjong is a serious 1-on-1 battle where the heroine "strips when she loses"!

This cutting-edge entertainment that secretly gained popularity in the corners of Japanese arcades 30 years ago revives in 2026.

What's more! She will even take off the "very last piece" that was unseen back in the day—!

◇ Features

  • The match screen dramatically evolves in 3D!
    Play mahjong alone together with the heroine—while she stays stripped!

    Through mahjong, you might just get to see a special side of her.

    You can even touch her during matches to enjoy her reactions...?

  • Beginner-friendly! Fully equipped with Auto Mode
    "I don't know the rules of mahjong..." Don't worry if that's you!

    Features an Auto Mode that fully automates gameplay with a single button.

    Enjoy the story and strip scenes effortlessly.

    (Can be toggled ON/OFF at any time during matches)

  • Complete freedom to toggle ON⇔OFF! Equipped with a "Compliance" feature to cover sensitive parts with a mysterious light
    Sensitive areas during mahjong matches and strip scenes can be covered with a "mysterious light."

    tPlease make use of this for gameplay in public places, streaming, etc.!

    tIn addition to toggling ON⇔OFF, the "size" can also be adjusted according to compliance strictness levels across different eras.

Now, experience zero-distance undressing!!
